question:
In a hydrogen discharge tube (assume an ideal hydrogen atom with infinitely heavy nucleus), three spectral lines are observed whose wavenumbers (in increasing order) are:

$$\tilde\nu_1=1.523611\times 10^6\,\text{m}^{-1},$$
$$\tilde\nu_2=2.056875\times 10^6\,\text{m}^{-1},$$
$$\tilde\nu_3=2.303700\times 10^6\,\text{m}^{-1}.$$

All three lines belong to the same spectral series, i.e. they correspond to transitions $n_{i}\to n_f$ with a common final level $n_f$ and three different initial levels $n_{i1}<n_{i2}<n_{i3}$.

Using the Rydberg formula
$$\tilde\nu = R\left(\frac{1}{n_f^2}-\frac{1}{n_i^2}\right),$$
identify $n_f$ and the ordered triple $(n_{i1},n_{i2},n_{i3})$..
